hooks.command: input=$(cat); tool=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_name // "?"' 2>/dev/null); file=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // "?"' 2>/dev/null); echo "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') PostToolUse tool=${tool:-?} file=${file:-?}" >> "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/hook.log"
